vulnerable.description: Live API key literal used as a Bearer token
Database password literal in a config object
AWS AKIA-prefixed access key id plus 40-char secret literal
GitHub ghp_-prefixed personal access token literal
HS256 signing secret plus a JWT-shaped service token literal
Supabase service_role key behind NEXT_PUBLIC_, which inlines it into the browser bundle — a total Row Level Security bypass
service_role read inside a "use client" module, which ships to the browser with it

safe.description: The word 'password' as UI copy, not a value
Secret-shaped variable NAMES bound to process.env reads (no literal values)
The anon key in a client component, which is what it is for
service_role in a module importing `server-only`, where the build stops the client reaching it
